identity: An inhabited Ixtali arcology-edge district with monumental council/study institutions, practical local craft and negotiated independent-fauna refuge sites. Compressed game geography is project fiction.
camera: Theatrical low three-quarter matte view, slightly elevated eye and elevated horizon. Readable frontal entrances, substantial distant monuments, larger near service facades, asymmetrical planted terrace courts and curved/diagonal access branches.

coast.placement: Whole quay and pylon-supported right-hand gangway; ship includes complete dock/boathouse plus vessel because it replaces Shipyard visually.

grail.placement: Separate rare slender axiom pylon, not an ordinary site or duplicate council.

heraldry.placement: Permanent physical civic route cloth in terrain plus generous jade/gold banners and carved plaques in ordinary building states. Shape viewed against the actual official alpha reference; no generic leaf or borrowed region crest.

art_method: Genuine built-in imagegen painted2D composition and transparent state masters, deterministic uniform family scaling around measured entrance roots, actual PNG alpha, masks/highlights and native BuildingID-indexed HALL.
accepted_scope: Coordinator source-composition direction only. Actual game rendering/clicks/tooltips/construction progression, final external art and redistribution acceptance remain pending.
